node.title: M720 h=3,4,5 ground-truth replay
node.statement: The M720 gate arithmetic reproduces the banked h=3,4,5 calibration facts: full_census(16,3,17)=352, full_census(16,3,97)=16, full_census(128,3,17921)=18 anchored cores, full_census(256,3,65537)=129 anchored cores, full_census(16,4,17)=120 non-toral + 6 toral, and full_census(32,5,97)=96 trades.
node.attack_surface: assembly from local small-gate replay and the remaining off-laptop larger calibration rows
node.falsifier: any replay returning a different count, or a corrected banked calibration table
